business_problem: T-Mobile needed more accurate, lower-latency call transcripts so its Expert Assist software could recommend answers in real time without making customers repeat themselves in noisy service interactions.
solution_summary: T-Mobile embedded NVIDIA speech AI into its Expert Assist workflow so frontline agents could see reliable transcripts and recommendations while calls were still in progress. Audio from customer conversations is processed on NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPUs with NVIDIA Riva handling low-latency automatic speech recognition. T-Mobile engineers used NVIDIA NeMo to fine-tune speech models on proprietary customer-care data so the system could recognize product jargon, accents, and noisy call-center conditions. The live transcripts feed Expert Assist, which recommends next-best actions and helps agents resolve issues faster. The stack is designed for thousands of concurrent users, combining custom model training with GPU-accelerated inference to keep accuracy high while maintaining real-time responsiveness in production.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU
solution_components.role: Provides the accelerated compute used to run T-Mobile's speech models for live customer-care workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo
solution_components.role: Lets T-Mobile fine-tune ASR models on custom customer-service data so jargon and noisy environments are handled more accurately.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Riva
solution_components.role: Runs low-latency speech recognition in production so Expert Assist can transcribe calls in real time.

data_flow: Customer-call audio is processed by Riva on NVIDIA GPUs, custom NeMo-tuned ASR models generate transcripts, and Expert Assist uses those transcripts to surface recommendations to frontline agents during the conversation.
business_outcome: T-Mobile improved transcript accuracy by 10 percent, reduced latency by 10X, and delivered real-time speech assistance for thousands of concurrent users while preserving its customer-service experience.
